action.onSelected: qs ipc call background set '{{ path }}'; change-colortheme -c '{{ colorHex }}'
action.onPreview: exit 0; qs ipc call background preview '{{ path }}'; change-colortheme -c '{{ colorHex }}' quickshell niri

saveState.command: qs ipc call colors get mPrimary

action.onRestore: exit 0; qs ipc call background preview ''; change-colortheme -c '{{ flavor }}' quickshell niri
